FIGURE.TITLE_EN: Fiscal incidence of taxes and transfers, Senegal
FIGURE.CAPTION_EN: Direct and indirect taxes, social contributions, transfers, subsidies and in-kind benefits, as a percentage of market income plus pensions per capita, by decile, Senegal.
FIGURE.ALT_TEXT_EN: Stacked bar chart with two overlaid lines showing fiscal incidence by decile of market income plus pensions per capita in Senegal. Bars decompose direct taxes, social security contributions, direct transfers, subsidies, indirect taxes and in-kind transfers for deciles 1 to 10; a blue line shows the net cash position and a red line the total position, both declining from about 8 percent of market income for the poorest decile to negative values for the richest decile.
